name: Bell Busk
notes: Former Craven District Council area outside the Yorkshire Dales National Park; listed in the council's Craven list of 29 conservation areas. The council publishes no appraisal for it (the 2023 Craven appraisals cover other areas). Designated by Craven DC on 30 April 1996; the Craven layer gives 27.27 ha in Craven and 1.09 ha in the National Park. The Yorkshire Dales NPA holds a separate 0.8 ha 'Bell Busk' entity (44002785) for its part; this record is the 28.4 ha Craven-designated polygon (the council layer marks both polygons as YDNPA-designated, but the Craven list and Craven layer say 'Designated by CDC'). Doubt: a reviewer may decide that the YDNPA entity should hold the whole area. The 0.8 ha part inside the Yorkshire Dales National Park is held by the park authority (PDP 44002785), so the polygon is clipped to the North Yorkshire LPA boundary.
